title: Review of c51's chiral eating-flocks negative on fresh seed 42 (chi 0.03, chi 0.2, and chi 0.03 at world dt/2): churning crescent hooks with no track longer than 100 t and 0 persistent splits; chi 0.2 gives still, splitting spots
summary: Labkit re-runs of the finding's world.py on seed 42, 128^2, 300 frames x 40 steps (t=3000, 10 t per frame). chi 0.03: crescent hooks that churn (sheet t=400-3000); 2441 tracks, longest 10 frames (100 t), 0 persistent tracks, 863 splits against 828 merges, 0 persistent splits, at most 2.3 body lengths. chi 0.2: 55 persistent tracks, 17 persistent splits, generation 3, merge/split 0.85, at most 0.6 body lengths (spots rotate in place). chi 0.03 at the world's own dt halved (dt 0.125, 80 steps per frame): 2490 tracks, longest 10 frames, 0 persistent splits, merge/split 0.96.

observations.M: rerun/seed42_chi0.03/FACTS.md: longest track 100 t, 0 persistent splits, merge/split 0.96; rerun/seed42_chi0.2/FACTS.md: 17 persistent splits but max 0.6 body lengths; dt/2 arm the same as chi 0.03

seeds_run.result: pass (negative replicates, also at world dt/2)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and labkit's default threshold. With c51's threshold 0.45 tracks may be longer (c51's longest is 300 t), but no setting gives persistent motile individuals.
